description.zh:
查询资源时的筛选键。

与FilterValue配合使用，取值必须为FsId或FsName。

传入FsId则根据数据库文件系统的实例ID进行筛选，传入FsName则根据数据库文件系统的实例名称进行筛选。
description.en:
The filter key when querying resources.

Use with FilterValue. Valid values: FsId or FsName.

If you specify FsId, the system filters by DBFS instance ID. If you specify FsName, the system filters by DBFS instance name.

description.zh:
查询资源时的筛选值。

与FilterKey配合使用。
description.en:
The filter value when querying resources.

Use with FilterKey.

The current page number.

Default value: 1.

description.zh:
分页查询时设置的每页条数。

最大值：100。

默认值：10。
description.en:
The number of entries per page for paged queries.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10.

description.zh: DBFS实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the DBFS instance. Call [DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html) to view the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions.

description.zh:
查询资源时设置排序方式。

与SortType配合使用，取值必须为SizeG或CreatedTime。

取值为SizeG则根据容量排序，取值为CreatedTime则根据创建时间排序。

默认根据创建时间倒序排列。
description.en:
The field to sort by when querying resources.

Use with SortType. Valid values: SizeG or CreatedTime.

If you set SortKey to SizeG, results are sorted by capacity. If you set it to CreatedTime, results are sorted by creation time.

By default, results are sorted in descending order by creation time.

description.zh:
查询资源时设置排序方式。

与SortKey配合使用，取值必须为asc或desc。

取值为asc则正序排列，取值为desc则正序排列。

默认根据创建时间倒序排列。
description.en:
The sort order when querying resources.

Use with SortKey. Valid values: asc or desc.

If you set SortType to asc, results are sorted in ascending order. If you set it to desc, results are sorted in descending order.

By default, results are sorted in descending order by creation time.

description.zh:
根据标签筛选数据库文件系统列表。

TagKey：资源的标签键。取值范围：最大长度为64个字符，可包含英文大小写字母、中文、数字和特殊符号@_-=+;:,<.>/?

 TagValue：资源的标签值。取值范围：最大长度为128个字符，可包含英文大小写字母、中文、数字和特殊符号@_-=+;:,<.>/?
description.en:
Filter the list of DBFS instances by tags.

TagKey: The tag key of the resource. Valid values: Up to 64 characters. Can include uppercase and lowercase letters, Chinese characters, digits, and special characters @ \_ - = + ; : , < . > / ?

TagValue: The tag value of the resource. Valid values: Up to 128 characters. Can include uppercase and lowercase letters, Chinese characters, digits, and special characters @ \_ - = + ; : , < . > / ?

title.zh: 查询数据库文件系统列表
title.en: Query the list of database file systems
